name: bank-transfer-details
title: Bank transfer details
description: How to pay by bank transfer: beneficiary, IBAN, BIC, the exact amount and the reference, each with a copy button, and the deadline.
docs: details (a BankTransferAccount) holds the account: beneficiary, iban, an optional bic, amount in minor units and the reference. The IBAN is shown in groups of four and copied without spaces, the amount is copied without a symbol and with the decimal mark of locale, and the reference is copied exactly as given. onCopy receives the row ("iban") and the text that reached the clipboard. deadline is when the order lapses, written in timeZone; pass now from the server and a deadline that has passed turns the buttons off and says so at the top of the card, in place of the instructions. Without now nothing is ever shown as lapsed. In a card narrower than 26rem the copy buttons are only their icon (still named Copy IBAN), so an account number keeps one line. labels holds every word, for another language.
